title: dyes update in 1.21.9 25w31a snapshot
body:
This resource pack updates the appearance of dye textures by replacing the default, outdated graphics with a more modern, detailed, and visually appealing design. Thanks to the new textures, dyes become more vibrant and easier to distinguish, which enhances both the overall visual experience of the game and the convenience of using them in crafting and decoration. The pack fits seamlessly into the game's style and preserves its original atmosphere, while offering improved visuals without compromising performance
